title: Finite locally free of degree d descends along etale coverings (Stacks 02VO)
statement: Let $h:Y\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $d\ge0$ an integer, and $(\varphi_i:T_i\to T)_{i\in I}$ a family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] whose images cover $T$, $T=\bigcup_i\varphi_i(T_i)$. If for every $i$ the base change $Y\times_TT_i\to T_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is finite locally free of degree $d$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free], then $h$ is finite locally free of degree $d$.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02VO (lemma-descending-property-finite-locally-free), line 6225, with its proof (Morphisms 02KB and the fpqc descent of finite, flat, locally of finite presentation); an etale covering is an fpqc covering by Topologies, Lemma Tag 022C (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc)

proof.text: *The family $(\varphi_i)$ is an fpqc covering of $T$.* Every $\varphi_i$ is flat, since an etale morphism is flat, locally of finite presentation and unramified [def-weil-etale-morphism]; this is the first condition of [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let $V\subseteq T$ be an affine open. For each $i$ write the open subscheme $\varphi_i^{-1}(V)\subseteq T_i$ as a union $\bigcup_{j\in J_i}V_{ij}$ of affine opens $V_{ij}\subseteq T_i$ (the affine opens of the scheme $T_i$ form a basis of its topology [def-pc-scheme]). Each $\varphi_i$ is an open map [lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map], so every $\varphi_i(V_{ij})$ is open in $T$, and it lies in $V$. They cover $V$: for $v\in V$ there are $i$ and $t\in T_i$ with $\varphi_i(t)=v$ (the images of the $\varphi_i$ cover $T$), and then $t\in\varphi_i^{-1}(V)$, so $t\in V_{ij}$ for some $j$ and $v\in\varphi_i(V_{ij})$. Thus $V=\bigcup_{i,j}\varphi_i(V_{ij})$ is an open covering of $V$; as $V$ is affine it is quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs], so finitely many $\varphi_{i_1}(V_{i_1j_1}),\dots,\varphi_{i_n}(V_{i_nj_n})$ already cover $V$. This is the second condition of [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], so $\{\varphi_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering of $T$.

source.place: Topologies, Lemma Tag 022C (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc, line 3044) and its proof (the f_i are flat; f_i^{-1}(V) covered by affine opens V_ij; f_i open; V quasi-compact, finite refinement), for an etale covering

proof.text: *$h$ is finite.* Write $h_i:Y\times_TT_i\to T_i$ for the base change of $h$ along $\varphi_i$ (second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]). By hypothesis $h_i$ is finite locally free, i.e. finite, flat and locally of finite presentation [def-pc-finite-locally-free]; in particular every $h_i$ is finite. Since $\{\varphi_i\}$ is an fpqc covering (step 1), $h$ is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-finite].

source.place: Descent, proof of Lemma Tag 02VO (lemma-descending-property-finite-locally-free, line 6225): finite locally free = finite, flat, locally of finite presentation (Morphisms 02KB, here the definition), and Lemma Tag 02LA (lemma-descending-property-finite)

proof.text: *$h$ is flat.* Every $h_i$ is flat (step 2, [def-pc-finite-locally-free]); since $\{\varphi_i\}$ is an fpqc covering (step 1), $h$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-flat].

source.place: Descent, proof of Lemma Tag 02VO, and Lemma Tag 02L2 (lemma-descending-property-flat)

proof.text: *$h$ is locally of finite presentation, hence finite locally free.* Every $h_i$ is locally of finite presentation (step 2, [def-pc-finite-locally-free]); since $\{\varphi_i\}$ is an fpqc covering (step 1), $h$ is locally of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-locally-finite-presentation]. With steps 2 and 3, $h$ is finite, flat and locally of finite presentation, i.e. finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free].

source.place: Descent, proof of Lemma Tag 02VO, and Lemma Tag 02KY (lemma-descending-property-locally-finite-presentation)

proof.text: *The degree is $d$.* Let $t\in T$, with residue field $\kappa(t)$ [def-weil-residue-field] and fibre $Y_t=Y\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Since $h$ is finite (step 2), the projection $Y_t\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$, a base change of $h$, is finite [lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence] (a); so $Y_t$ is finite over $\kappa(t)$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound], and let $e=\dim_{\kappa(t)}\Gamma(Y_t,\mathcal O_{Y_t})$ be its degree. As the images of the $\varphi_i$ cover $T$, choose $i$ and $t_i\in T_i$ with $\varphi_i(t_i)=t$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-base-change] to $h:Y\to T$, $g=\varphi_i:T_i\to T$ and the point $t_i$ over $t$: the fibre of $h_i:Y\times_TT_i\to T_i$ at $t_i$ is finite over $\kappa(t_i)$ of degree $e$. Since $h_i$ is finite locally free of degree $d$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free], that degree is $d$; hence $e=d$. As $t\in T$ was arbitrary and $h$ is finite locally free (step 4), $h$ is finite locally free of degree $d$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free].
